newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via 4-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via 4-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to inject reserves into the banking system Thursday through a round of four-day system repurchase agreements.
Overnight system RPs are possible if the Fed decides to be cautious, analysts said.

Analysts said that with a $1.5-$2.0 billion daily add need seen in the second half of the maintenance period, and with Tuesday's two-day system RP operation running off, an operation this session is certain.
Today's RP was projected at $2.0-$3.0 billion.
Fed funds were trading at the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target rate.
